propositions: Repository-owned code-review project criteria must be injected exactly once into round_a and never into round_b, with each project finding retaining its logical criterion id in the project.<name> namespace
The repository-scoped effective routing map governs deterministic threshold, blocking, advisory, and nit-suppression decisions for the logical project id in Pass 3
A project code-review id active in exactly one gate resolves and calibrates through the code-review arm of criteria eval; unknown and cross-gate-ambiguous ids are rejected before calibration
An activated project criterion with a missing or invalid prompt/eval specification raises a located configuration error rather than silently falling back
Docs/llm-framework.md lacks a normative Code-review project criteria section describing the runtime contract across fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval resolution, and CLI admission
